description_en: Updates time variables for a task
name: UpdateTaskTimeVariables

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

> :To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task node. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html operation to query the node ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务节点ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The time variables configured for the node. The value of this parameter must be a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 节点变量，时间变量配置。取值类型为JSON格式的字符串
parameters.name: time_variables
